title: Core: group and ungroup display objects
description: Implement groupObject(doc, sceneIndex, layerIndex, frameIndex, objectIds[]): FlashDocument and ungroupObject(doc, sceneIndex, layerIndex, frameIndex, groupId): FlashDocument in packages/core/src/engine/mutations.ts. Flash 8 grouping wraps selected objects in a GroupObject container (Modify > Group, Ctrl+G). Ungrouping extracts children back to the parent frame (Modify > Ungroup, Ctrl+Shift+G). If GroupObject type doesn't exist in DisplayObject union, add it to types.ts first. Add 8 unit tests in __tests__/grouping.test.ts.
